findings.issue: The class this task was to close is still open in a live command: refs_rule() puts only plugins/audit/scripts on sys.path (`sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join("plugins", "audit", "scripts"))`) and then runs `import _refs`, which no longer resolves (verified in the task tree: python3 -I with that preamble raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named '_refs', exit 1). refs_rule backs the release followers (verify.sh:991-994, raw_url_pin_drift, artifact_version_drift, screenshot_capture_drift), so `verify.sh --release` is broken. The task's grep excluded `:!tools`, and mv6 reads only .py string literals and evals.json, so a shell heredoc is outside the lint: the claims block says the grep was complete (4 hits, all repointed) while the class is not closed.

Widen mv6/_shipped_literals to also read *.sh and *.mjs/*.yml under tools/ and .github/ (or add a text-level scan of the heredoc), with the planted shape mv7 already uses, so the next shell caller turns red.
